implementation.syntax: export fn; from "./file.kalandra" import name, other as alias
implementation.loading: Bounded canonical-path acyclic source graph, independent per-file parsing then checked graph composition; retained source parts map spans to original files
implementation.resolution: Module-local definitions and explicit import aliases resolved to original function IDs; dependency functions get distinct internal names and cannot become root main
implementation.lowering: Shared typed calls, callbacks and CPU continuations; multi-file MLIR includes source locations
implementation.tools: CPU checker/compiler load graphs; compiler rejects all executable/LLVM/MLIR destinations aliasing dependency sources

contract.visibility: Private by default; only named exported functions imported; imports not re-exported
contract.types: Existing concrete numeric, Bool, collection and TaskError rules; no implicit conversions
contract.paths: Explicit ./ or ../ .kalandra files relative to importing canonical file; UTF-8 paths, canonical/symlink deduplication
contract.limits: 128 files, 32 import edges of depth including cached subgraphs, 16 MiB aggregate source including separators; aggregate token/expression limits
contract.diagnostics: Original file/line/byte-column/excerpt for frontend errors; original runtime fault line/column, file identity not yet in fault ABI
contract.workers: Imported direct/nested calls and callbacks, owned captures, cached results and recovery use existing scheduler/runtime

scope: Frontend debug and ASan/UBSan: named exports/aliases, duplicate/private/missing bindings, exact numeric and shape contracts, imported named/anonymous callbacks and helper isolation
Canonical diamond/symlink identity, parent-relative and UTF-8 filenames, cycles including symlinks, file/depth/aggregate byte/token limits and cached-subgraph depth
Original semantic/syntax diagnostic file/line/excerpts, multi-file emitted MLIR locations, import-only modules and root-entry isolation, malformed declarations and unresolved/placement import gates
Six numeric types across reusable multi-file helper/callback graphs; direct/nested workers, retained array outcomes, repeated awaits, empty arrays and imported Arithmetic recovery
1/2/4-worker success/cancellation/deadline/admission; task-core and invocation allocation-failure positions 1-8; output lifetimes after worker/core/invocation shutdown
Imported Bool worker result and imported runtime shape guard; dependency fault line/column retained
Fresh dependency rebuilds change only newly compiled executables; private helper and dependency main isolation
Executable/LLVM/MLIR source-output protection including symlink/hardlink aliases; failed graph/type/child-diagnostic checks preserve all existing requested artifacts

Existing syntax/semantic/collection/numeric/control frontends, source/tasks/recovery/storage/continuations, representative collection runtime checks and selected Metal regressions; focused qualification, not a full-suite claim

remaining_gates: Package resolution, namespace/wildcard imports and re-export declarations
User-defined type/value exports and broader native data forms
Public native object/static/shared-library ABI and packaging
